symptom: A button whose flow call has output mappings (Mendix 11.5, Forms$MicroflowSettings / Forms$CallNanoflowClientAction .OutputMappings) lost them on describe → exec: describe printed nothing for them, exec reported Replaced page and wrote the empty list; mx check silent
cause: MDL has no syntax for output mappings and no fixture or Studio Pro sample shows a populated one, so the rebuild could only write the empty list Studio Pro stores on every other call (written since 2026-10-10, which fixed the empty-list drop #977 originally recorded)
file: modelsdk/canon/outputmappings.go (CarryOutputMappings, wired into Reconcile before TransplantIDs), mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_parse.go + _output.go (countOutputMappings, outputMappingsNote)
insight: When a property has no syntax and no measured shape, carry it rather than invent it: pair the stored and rebuilt holder by owning named element + path (exact, list-free, unique — the same addressing as the translation carry), carry only into an EMPTY rebuilt list and only while the call names the same flow, and keep ids verbatim so the canonical form sees the same elements. Length-changing carries must run before TransplantIDs. Check an issue's remaining scope against main before building: #977's recorded symptom (the empty list) had been fixed six days after it was filed; the propdist tally (180/180 empty) and a BSON-patched probe separated that from the live non-empty case
